job.title: Monitoring and Insights Analyst
job.description:
9-Month Fixed-Term Contract | Wellington

Do you enjoy turning complex data into meaningful performance insights? We're looking for an experienced Monitoring and Insights Analyst to play a key role in strengthening organisational performance measurement capability and improving the quality, consistency and integrity of reporting across a large and complex environment.

This is an opportunity to lead the development and enhancement of performance measures, establish robust governance and stewardship practices, and leave a lasting legacy through sustainable measurement frameworks and processes.

What you'll be doing
You'll work closely with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, and data professionals to:
  • Develop, implement and maintain organisational performance measures
  • Improve existing measures to ensure they remain relevant, reliable and fit for purpose
  • Create clear measure definitions, methodologies, business rules and reporting documentation
  • Establish and embed measurement stewardship, governance and change control processes
  • Develop and maintain measure metadata, ownership and audit requirements
  • Validate and test measures to ensure accuracy, transparency and consistency
  • Support performance reporting and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Provide expert advice on measurement methodologies, reporting requirements and data quality
  • Collaborate with data and analytics teams to deliver sustainable reporting solutions
What you'll bring
We're looking for someone with:
  • Proven experience developing and managing organisational performance measures and KPIs
  • Strong SQL and analytics capability, including data modelling, validation, testing and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Snowflake (highly desirable).
  • Power BI development proficiency.
  • Strong knowledge of performance reporting, governance and measurement frameworks
  • Experience establishing stewardship, metadata and measure lifecycle processes
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation capabilities
  • Experience working with complex datasets and reporting environments
  • Exposure to Snowflake or similar modern data platforms
  • Ability to translate business requirements into meaningful and measurable outcomes
  • Exceptional documentation and communication skills
Why this role?
This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact by improving how organisational performance is measured, reported and understood. You'll help build trusted, auditable and sustainable measurement practices that will continue delivering value long after the contract ends.

Apply now
If you're passionate about performance measurement, data integrity and helping organisations make better decisions through meaningful reporting, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Starfish Consulting for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Senior Business Analyst
job.description:
Auckland | Large-Scale Change Programme | Future State Design & Business Improvement

Are you a highly capable Senior Business Analyst who enjoys solving complex business challenges, shaping future operating models, and translating strategy into practical outcomes?

We are recruiting for a significant enterprise transformation programme focused on the future delivery of logistics, maintenance, asset management, engineering support, warehousing, and operational services across a large and complex organisation. This high-profile programme will influence how critical services are designed, delivered, and sustained well into the future.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a seasoned Business Analyst who can confidently operate between strategy and execution, engaging senior stakeholders while working hands-on to define requirements, analyse current operations, and design future-state solutions.

The Opportunity
Working alongside the Project Manager and programme leadership team, you will play a pivotal role in gathering, analysing, and translating complex information into clear recommendations and actionable business outcomes. You'll help shape future operating models, support organisational change initiatives, and drive business improvement across a major transformation programme.

What You'll Be Doing

Business Analysis & Discovery
  • Gather, assess, analyse, and communicate information from a wide range of operational and strategic sources.
  • Lead requirements elicitation, documentation, validation, and stakeholder sign-off.
  • Conduct solution analysis and support future-state design activities.
  • Translate complex business problems into practical and achievable recommendations.
Stakeholder Engagement
  • Plan and facilitate workshops, interviews, and stakeholder engagement sessions.
  • Build strong relationships across operational, technical, and executive stakeholder groups.
  • Navigate multiple viewpoints to drive alignment and informed decision-making.
  • Present insights and recommendations clearly and confidently.
Process & Operating Model Design
  • Map, analyse, and improve current business processes.
  • Develop future-state business models and capability frameworks.
  • Support business function design, organisational capability planning, and operating model development.
  • Identify opportunities for efficiency, effectiveness, and service improvement.
Change & Transformation Support
  • Contribute to change initiatives that support new ways of working.
  • Develop high-quality project artefacts including:
    • Business process documentation
    • Frameworks and methodologies
    • Policies and procedures
    • Training and support materials
    • Business cases and options papers
  • Support successful transition and adoption outcomes.
What We're Looking For
You'll bring:
  • 5+ years' experience as a Business Analyst within large and complex organisations.
  • Exceptional requirements gathering and stakeholder management experience.
  • Strong facilitation and workshop leadership skills.
  • Advanced business process modelling capability.
  • Experience developing frameworks, operating models, and future-state designs.
  • Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written communication and documentation expertise.
  • The ability to simplify complex information into clear business insights and recommendations.
Highly Desirable Experience
We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience across:
  • Enterprise logistics and supply chain environments.
  • Asset management and asset-intensive organisations.
  • Maintenance, engineering, manufacturing, or operational services.
  • Large-scale organisational transformation programmes.
  • Service redesign and operating model transformation.
  • Complex stakeholder environments where strategic and operational priorities intersect.
Personal Attributes
You'll be someone who:
  • Builds credibility and relationships quickly.
  • Thrives in ambiguity and complex environments.
  • Is proactive, organised, and outcomes-focused.
  • Rolls up their sleeves and gets things done.
  • Brings structure, clarity, and best-practice thinking.
  • Is resilient, adaptable, and highly collaborative.
Why This Role?
This is more than a traditional Business Analyst position.

You'll be part of a significant transformation programme that combines strategic analysis, future-state design, organisational change, and business improvement. You'll have the opportunity to influence key decisions, work closely with senior leaders, and help shape how critical logistics and operational services are delivered in the future.

If you're an experienced Senior Business Analyst with strong change delivery capability and proven experience across logistics, operations, supply chain, or large enterprise environments, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Starfish Consulting for a confidential discussion

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
Auckland | Long-Term Programme | Complex Change & Delivery Leadership

Are you an experienced Senior Project Manager who thrives in complex environments where strategic thinking, large-scale programme delivery, and organisational change intersect?

We are partnering with a major enterprise organisation undertaking a critical transformation programme that will shape the future delivery of logistics, asset management, maintenance, and supply chain services across a large and highly complex operational environment. This senior appointment will play a pivotal role in defining and delivering future logistics and support service models that align with long-term organisational objectives.

Working closely with executive stakeholders, you will lead project planning, governance, change delivery, stakeholder engagement, and implementation activities across multiple business units and operational functions. Success in this role will require you to balance strategic outcomes with practical delivery while navigating a complex stakeholder landscape. 

What You'll Be Responsible For

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans and delivery roadmaps
  • Manage timelines, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resources
  • Lead option analysis and solution development activities
  • Coordinate vendors, suppliers, and delivery partners

Governance & Reporting

  • Deliver high-quality executive reporting and insights

  • Facilitate governance forums, steering groups, and decision-making processes

Organisational Change & Transformation

  • Lead significant business change initiatives across a large enterprise environment
  • Drive stakeholder engagement, communications, and readiness activities
  • Support transition planning, adoption, and implementation
  • Enable sustainable change outcomes through effective people-focused delivery

Stakeholder Management

  • Influence and engage senior leaders and executives
  • Build trusted relationships across diverse operational and corporate functions
  • Navigate competing priorities and complex organisational dynamics
  • Create alignment around strategic objectives and future-state operating models

What We're Looking For

To succeed in this role, you'll bring:

  • 5+ years' experience delivering large-scale, complex projects and programmes
  • Proven experience leading organisational change and business transformation initiatives
  • Strong project planning, scheduling, and delivery management capability
  • Expertise in risk, issue, dependency, and governance management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and executive influence capability
  • Ability to think both strategically and operationally
  • Experience working in fast-paced, politically nuanced, or highly regulated environments

Highly Desirable Experience

We would be particularly interested in hearing from candidates who have experience in:

  • Enterprise logistics and supply chain transformation
  • Maintenance, engineering, warehousing, or asset-intensive operations
  • Contract transition or outsourced service delivery models
  • Complex operational environments with multiple stakeholder groups
  • Large-scale service redesign and operating model transformation

Why Apply?

This is a rare opportunity to lead a programme that will have long-term strategic impact across a large enterprise. You'll join a high-profile initiative where your ability to combine disciplined project delivery with exceptional change leadership will be critical to success.

If you're a Senior Project Manager with a track record of delivering complex transformation programmes and a strong understanding of logistics, operational services, and organisational change, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Test Engineer
job.description:
Test Engineer | Fixed Term Contract | 18months

Are you a hands-on Test Engineer who enjoys building robust automation frameworks, validating complex data, and ensuring critical systems perform as expected?

We're looking for an experienced Test Engineer to join a major transformation programme where you'll play a key role in delivering high-quality outcomes across banking and financial services products. This is an opportunity to work on complex integrations, data migrations, and API-driven solutions in a collaborative, delivery-focused environment.

What you'll be doing
As a Test Engineer, you'll be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated testing solutions that ensure systems are reliable, accurate, and fit for purpose. You'll work closely with business stakeholders, developers, and delivery teams to validate business requirements, improve test coverage, and support successful releases.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Building and maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites
  • Designing and executing API, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Validating complex business rules, calculations, and financial transactions
  • Performing migration and reconciliation testing across source and target systems
  • Querying and analysing data to validate outcomes and identify discrepancies
  • Supporting SIT and E2E testing activities, including defect triage and troubleshooting
  • Contributing to CI/CD pipelines and continuous quality practices
  • Ensuring clear traceability between requirements, test scenarios, and automation coverage
What you'll bring
We're looking for someone with strong technical testing capability combined with experience working in financial services or banking environments.
You'll ideally have:
  • Strong experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Postman, Bruno, NUnit/C#, Selenium, Cypress, RestAssured, or Karate
  • Solid programming skills in Java and/or Python
  • Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs, including JSON and XML validation
  • Strong SQL and database querying skills
  • Experience using Git and modern version control practices
  • A proven track record delivering automation within CI/CD environments such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions
  • Strong troubleshooting and defect investigation skills
Highly desirable experience
  • Banking, financial services, lending, payments, or core banking platforms
  • Data-driven testing approaches and parameterised automation frameworks
  • Data migration, reconciliation, and validation testing
  • Testing financial calculations, interest accruals, fees, or transaction processing
  • BDD frameworks and tools such as Gherkin or Cucumber
Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion.

Key Skills
Test Automation | Playwright | Postman | Selenium | Cypress | API Testing | Python | Java | SQL | Git | CI/CD | Jenkins | GitHub Actions | Data Migration | Reconciliation Testing | Banking | Financial Services | BDD | Cucumber | Gherkin
